senses.gloss: (b. h.) [to join closely (in a friendly or hostile sense);—Denom. כַּתְּ;] to press, crush. Part. pass. כָּתוּת, one whose parts are crushed. Sifra Emor Par. 7, ch. VII; Kidd. 25ᵇ; Bekh. 39ᵇ

units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 22:6">Gen. R. s. 22</cite> (with ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 89:24">Ps. LXXXIX, 24</cite>) <he>התחיל מְכַתְּתוֹ</he> he began to strike him; Yalk. ib. 36; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 840">Yalk. Ps. 840</cite>.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 23:2">Midr. Till. to Ps. XXIII</cite> <he>היה מה״מ מְכַתֵּת וכ׳</he> the angel of death smote fifteen thousand and some of them.

<cite ref="Berakhot 63b:15">Ber. 63ᵇ</cite> (play on <he>ה̇ס̇כ̇ת̇</he>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 27:9">Deut. XXVII, 9</cite>) <he>כַּתְּתוּ עצמיכם וכ׳</he> expose yourselves to being smitten (by death) over the study of the Law.

Ab. Zar. 44ᵃ כִּיתְּתוֹ ground it (the bronze serpent) to powder.—Trnsf. (cmp. גרס) to discuss, argue. Ber. l. c. הֹסֹ ואח״כ כַֹּתֵֹּת first listen (and receive) and then discuss.—Part. pass. מְכוּתָּת, f. מְכוּתֶּתֶת, pl. מְכוּתָּתִין, v. כָּתַשׁ.D
